name: OpenScreen
title: OpenScreen: free Screen Studio alternative
hook: Screen Studio charges you a hundred and eight bucks a year to make screen demos. This app does it for free.

features.say: Record your screen or one window, with your mic and system audio.
It zooms in by itself, following your cursor. Pick a background, then export an MP4 or GIF.
Captions are written on your device, no upload.

caption:
Screen Studio charges $108/year ($29 if you pay monthly). OpenScreen turns your screen recordings into slick demos for free 🎬

✅ Record a window or your whole screen, with mic and system audio
✅ Auto zooms that follow your cursor, plus backgrounds and a webcam overlay
✅ Captions made on your device, no upload
✅ Export MP4 or GIF, no subscription, no watermarks, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ It's under active development, so expect some rough edges. The optional AI editing assistant needs your own API key.

Comment "DEMO" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
